effort.documented_mapping: the requested effort max maps to the actual effort max; thinking mode is enabled by default
effort.wire_ambiguity: the OpenCode Console docs name the endpoint and the model as OpenAI-compatible, but do not document the gateway's acceptance of DeepSeek's top-level thinking object or reasoning_effort field; no live probe was made

limits.reservation_ceiling_derivation: 200,000 context - 32,000 max output = 168,000; this is a conservative local reservation bound, not a measured tokenization or a provider-enforced input limit
limits.vendor_default_warning: DeepSeek's direct API documents a 128K default max_tokens when reasoning_effort is max; the free OpenCode catalog limit is 32K output. This profile pins the lower documented catalog limit and never assumes 128K.
limits.source_values: context = 200_000; output = 32_000 (values from the linked TOML, not a verbatim quote)

structured_output.conditions: set response_format to {"type": "json_object"}; include the word JSON in a system or user message and provide an example; set a reasonable max_tokens; the API may still return empty content

thinking_mode.tool_calls: supported in thinking mode; tool_choice required and named choices are not supported while thinking is enabled

qualification.reason: no live model/provider call, no calibration scores, no independently qualified judging profile, no target credential, no OpenCode endpoint approval in the live billing record, and no target-specific spend authorization

facts: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Free has model ID deepseek-v4.1-flash-free and endpoint https://opencode.ai/inference/openai/v1/chat/completions using @ai-sdk/openai-compatible.
The Console pricing table lists DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Free as Free for input, output and cached read.
base_model = deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash
structured_output = true
reasoning_options type = effort with values low, high, max
interleaved field = reasoning_content
cost input = 0, output = 0, cache_read = 0
limit context = 200_000 and output = 32_000
provider api = https://opencode.ai/inference/openai/v1
Thinking mode is enabled by default, with the default effort being high.
The OpenAI-format control is {"thinking": {"type": "enabled/disabled"}} and {"reasoning_effort": "low/high/max"}.
The requested effort max maps to the actual effort max.
Thinking mode does not support temperature, presence_penalty, or frequency_penalty; setting them has no effect.
With tools present, reasoning_content from previous turns must be passed back in later requests.
reasoning_effort accepts none, low, high, max; none disables thinking, the others enable it; the default is high.
max_tokens when reasoning_effort is max defaults to 128K; the total input and generated tokens are limited by the model context length.
required and named tool_choice are not supported in thinking mode; the API returns 400.
response_format supports text and json_object.
finish_reason values include stop, length, content_filter, tool_calls, insufficient_system_resource and aborted.
usage carries prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens, prompt_cache_hit_tokens, prompt_cache_miss_tokens and completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens.
To enable JSON Output, set response_format to {"type": "json_object"} and include the word json in the system or user prompt with an example of the desired format.
Set max_tokens reasonably to prevent the JSON string from being truncated.
The API may occasionally return empty content when using JSON Output.

ambiguities: The OpenCode Console documentation names the endpoint and model but does not document the gateway's exact wire mapping for DeepSeek's thinking object or reasoning_effort. The offline adapter models DeepSeek's documented body shape; any live use must verify the gateway and remain blocked until then.

The target's free list price is $0.00, but the free label's duration and future price are not documented. The profile keeps a separate metered-sibling bound ($0.30 input / $1.20 output per MTok) for budget reservations; zero price does not bypass qualification or authorization.
Context 200,000 and output 32,000 are catalog limits. The 168,000 input reservation ceiling is derived arithmetic, not a provider-enforced tokenizer limit.
DeepSeek's direct API can default max_tokens to 128K with reasoning_effort max, above the free catalog's 32K output cap. The adapter pins 32K.
JSON Output can return empty content or truncate when finish_reason is length; the adapter treats both as failures, never as successful structured output.
Tool-call history in thinking mode must preserve reasoning_content; the adapter rejects a tools request whose assistant history omits it.
No OpenCode calibration harness exists in this repository. tools/calibration/run.template.js is written for the Claude Code workflow harness, so no run was launched.
The checked-in live billing qualification remains deliberately unqualified and is bound to Anthropic's request mode; it does not approve the OpenCode endpoint.
